title: Tiny Bees Cook a Giant Hornet Alive Without a Single Sting
subject: honeybees

scenes.text: A hornet that can wipe out a hive meets bees that never sting it.
Japanese honeybees swarm it into a living ball.
They shiver their muscles, and the ball hits 46 degrees Celsius.
Carbon dioxide inside climbs to 4 percent, which makes the hornet less heat-proof.
The hornet dies within about 10 minutes.
The bees survive. They just cooked a killer using nothing but body heat.

description:
A hornet that can wipe out a hive meets bees that never sting it.
Japanese honeybees form a ball around it, reach 46 degrees Celsius and cook it in about 10 minutes.
Which animal would you bet on, the hornet or the bees?
